description: Staff scheduling API — offline plausible, RTM ambiguous, auth confirmed

expectations.assertion: Asks about offline access AND references staff assignments or event schedules as the reason
passing_examples: staff assignments and event schedules — data that field workers often need offline
I can see this returns event and staff data — do users need offline access?
failing_examples: Do mobile users need offline access?

expectations.assertion: Asks about RTM AND notes that no push/websocket endpoints were found in the spec
passing_examples: The spec has no push or websocket endpoints — is real-time update needed?
I found no RTM endpoints — does the app need live data changes?
failing_examples: Does this API need real-time updates?

expectations.assertion: Does NOT ask about authentication — JWT Bearer is confirmed in securitySchemes
expectations.reason: components.securitySchemes.bearerAuth is present — auth type is determinable from spec

expectations.assertion: Does NOT ask about versioning — /v2/ is present in the server URL
expectations.reason: servers[0].url = https://api.acme.com/v2 — version is in the path

expectations.assertion: Asks about write frequency OR flags POST /bookings missing idempotency AND references the specific endpoint
passing_examples: POST /bookings has no idempotency key — how often does mobile create bookings?
I noticed /bookings has no Idempotency-Key support — is this called automatically or manually?
failing_examples: Does the app retry failed requests?

expectations.assertion: States an inference about offset pagination rather than asking — offset+limit params are visible in spec
passing_examples: I can see /events uses offset+limit pagination — I'll flag this as a concern
Treating /events as offset-paginated based on the offset and limit params
failing_examples: What type of pagination does this API use?

expectations.assertion: Asks no more than 5 questions total

description: Payment processing API — online-only, ephemeral data, no offline or RTM needed

expectations.assertion: Does NOT ask about offline sync — payment flows are inherently online, should be inferred
expectations.reason: Endpoints are /payments, /charges, /refunds — payment processing is an online-only operation

expectations.assertion: Does NOT ask about RTM — or if it does, frames it as unlikely given the payment context
expectations.reason: Payment creation and retrieval are transactional — RTM push is rarely needed

expectations.assertion: Asks about or flags idempotency for POST /payments AND references the financial risk
passing_examples: POST /payments — a duplicate charge from a retry would be a serious issue. Is there an idempotency key?
I see no Idempotency-Key on payment creation — retries could cause double charges

description: HAR with rate limit headers, ETag, and Accept-Language — these should not be asked about

expectations.assertion: Does NOT ask about rate limits — X-RateLimit-* headers are present in the HAR responses
expectations.reason: HAR shows X-RateLimit-Limit: 1000 and X-RateLimit-Remaining headers — confirmed from traffic

expectations.assertion: Does NOT ask about localisation — Accept-Language header is present in HAR requests
expectations.reason: HAR requests include Accept-Language: en-US — localisation is already being handled client-side

expectations.assertion: States an inference about caching from ETag headers rather than asking
passing_examples: ETag headers are present in responses — I'll treat caching as partially supported
Treating caching as present based on ETag observed in HAR
